#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Generic paid /plan-ai V2 live gate.
 * Authenticated POST /api/ai/chat. No demo, no fixture wiring, no prompt edits.
 * Saves raw terminal envelopes. Does not rewrite answers.
 */
'use strict';

// Local gate auth is stored under the server's existing admin env names.
// This maps credentials only; prompts, ordering, request shape, and grading stay unchanged.
require('../../server/node_modules/dotenv').config({ path: pathForServerEnv() });
process.env.TRAILIE_AUTH_EMAIL ||= process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL;
process.env.TRAILIE_AUTH_PASSWORD ||= process.env.REACT_APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD;

const crypto = require('crypto');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const http = require('http');

function pathForServerEnv() {
  return require('path').resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', 'server', '.env');
}

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname);
const PLAN_STAGE_DIR = path.resolve(ROOT, '..', 'private', 'plan_stages');
const PLAN_STAGE_PREFIX = 'generic-live-gate-after-valid__attempt-';
const API_BASE = process.env.API_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:5001';
const TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.LIVE_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS || 600000);
const ONLY = (process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith('--only=')) || '')
  .replace('--only=', '')
  .split(',')
  .filter(Boolean);

const THREADS = [
  {
    id: 'A',
    title: 'Yellowstone conversation continuity',
    turns: [
      {
        key: 'A1-duration-advice',
        prompt: 'Is three days enough for Yellowstone?',
      },
      {
        key: 'A2-which-airport',
        prompt: 'Which airport should I use?',
      },
      {
        key: 'A3-coming-from-dallas',
        prompt: "I'm coming from Dallas.",
      },
      {
        key: 'A4-build-itinerary',
        prompt: 'Okay, build me a realistic day-by-day itinerary.',
      },
      {
        key: 'A5-make-day-2-slower',
        prompt: 'Make Day 2 slower and reduce driving.',
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'B',
    title: 'Alaska trip skeleton, no itinerary',
    turns: [
      {
        key: 'B1-alaska-skeleton',
        prompt:
          "Plan realistic logistics, prices, places, and things to do for two people traveling to Alaska for 10 days in 2027. Don't make a day-by-day itinerary yet.",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'C',
    title: 'Hard-constraint Zion itinerary',
    turns: [
      {
        key: 'C1-zion-no-exposure',
        prompt:
          'Plan a realistic 2-day Zion trip for a couple who wants scenic views, easy-to-moderate hiking, and no exposed scary trails.',
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'D',
    title: 'Glacier operational advice',
    turns: [
      {
        key: 'D1-glacier-backup',
        prompt:
          "I'm visiting Glacier with only one full day. What should I prioritize, and what's a good backup if Logan Pass access or parking doesn't work?",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'E',
    title: 'Unseen older-traveler Grand Teton',
    turns: [
      {
        key: 'E1-teton-parents',
        prompt:
          "My parents are in their late 60s and can't comfortably walk more than about a mile at a time. Is Grand Teton still worth visiting for three days, and what would you focus on?",
      },
    ],
  },
];

function ensureDir(p) {
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
}

function writeJson(file, data) {
  ensureDir(path.dirname(file));
  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function snapshotPlanStages() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(PLAN_STAGE_DIR)) return new Map();
  return new Map(fs.readdirSync(PLAN_STAGE_DIR)
    .filter((name) => name.startsWith(PLAN_STAGE_PREFIX) && name.endsWith('.json'))
    .map((name) => [name, fs.statSync(path.join(PLAN_STAGE_DIR, name)).mtimeMs]));
}

function copyChangedPlanStages(before, threadDir, turnKey) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(PLAN_STAGE_DIR)) return [];
  const copied = [];
  for (const name of fs.readdirSync(PLAN_STAGE_DIR)) {
    if (!name.startsWith(PLAN_STAGE_PREFIX) || !name.endsWith('.json')) continue;
    const source = path.join(PLAN_STAGE_DIR, name);
    const mtimeMs = fs.statSync(source).mtimeMs;
    if (before.get(name) === mtimeMs) continue;
    const attempt = name.slice(PLAN_STAGE_PREFIX.length, -'.json'.length);
    const destination = path.join(threadDir, `${turnKey}-plan-stage-attempt-${attempt}.json`);
    fs.copyFileSync(source, destination);
    copied.push(path.basename(destination));
  }
  return copied;
}

function sanitizeForDisk(obj) {
  const scrubbed = JSON.stringify(obj)
    .replace(/Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]+/gi, 'Bearer [REDACTED]')
    .replace(/"password"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"/gi, '"password":"[REDACTED]"')
    .replace(/"token"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"/gi, '"token":"[REDACTED]"')
    .replace(/"cookie"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"/gi, '"cookie":"[REDACTED]"')
    .replace(/sk-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+/g, '[REDACTED_KEY]');
  return JSON.parse(scrubbed);
}

function requestJson(method, pathname, body, { headers = {}, timeoutMs = TIMEOUT_MS } = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const data = body == null ? '' : JSON.stringify(body);
    const url = new URL(pathname, API_BASE);
    const req = http.request(
      url,
      {
        method,
        headers: {
          ...(data ? {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(data),
          } : {}),
          'User-Agent': 'Trailie-Generic-Live-Gate/1.0',
          ...headers,
        },
      },
      (res) => {
        const chunks = [];
        res.on('data', (c) => chunks.push(c));
        res.on('end', () => {
          const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
          let json = null;
          try {
            json = JSON.parse(raw);
          } catch {
            json = { parseError: true, rawPreview: raw.slice(0, 4000) };
          }
          resolve({ status: res.statusCode, json, raw });
        });
      }
    );
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => {
      req.destroy();
      reject(new Error(`Timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms`));
    });
    if (data) req.write(data);
    req.end();
  });
}

function authHeaders(token) {
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
}

async function loginWithPassword() {
  const email = process.env.TRAILIE_AUTH_EMAIL;
  const password = process.env.TRAILIE_AUTH_PASSWORD;
  if (!email || !password) {
    throw new Error('TRAILIE_AUTH_EMAIL and TRAILIE_AUTH_PASSWORD are required');
  }
  const res = await requestJson('POST', '/api/auth/login', { email, password }, { timeoutMs: 30000 });
  if (res.status !== 200 || !res.json?.token) {
    throw new Error(`Login failed HTTP ${res.status}: ${String(res.raw || '').slice(0, 400)}`);
  }
  const user = res.json.data || {};
  return {
    token: res.json.token,
    user: {
      id: user.id || user._id,
      email: user.email,
      name: user.name,
      role: user.role,
    },
  };
}

function envelopeFromPayload(data) {
  return {
    content: data.content || '',
    canonicalPlan: data.itinerary || data.canonicalPlan || null,
    travelLogistics: data.travelLogistics ?? null,
    responseArtifacts: data.responseArtifacts ?? null,
    intent: data.intent ?? data.trailieV2?.intent ?? null,
    presentation: data.presentation ?? null,
    planningState: data.planningState ?? null,
    itineraryHash: data.itineraryHash || data.trailieV2?.itineraryHash || null,
    responseId: data.responseId || null,
    responseVersion: data.responseVersion ?? null,
    responseRevision: data.responseRevision ?? null,
    trailieV2: data.trailieV2 || null,
  };
}

function extractCapture(envelope, planningState) {
  const v2 = envelope.trailieV2 || {};
  const intent = envelope.intent || {};
  const plan = envelope.canonicalPlan;
  const days = Array.isArray(plan?.days) ? plan.days : [];
  const stopNames = days.flatMap((day) => (day.stops || []).map((stop) => stop.name || stop.title || null)).filter(Boolean);
  return {
    travelerJob: intent.travelerJob || null,
    primaryIntent: intent.primaryIntent || v2.intent || null,
    lastTravelerJob: planningState?.lastTravelerJob ?? envelope.planningState?.lastTravelerJob ?? null,
    activeDecision: planningState?.activeDecision ?? envelope.planningState?.activeDecision ?? null,
    intent,
    normalizedPlanningState: planningState || envelope.planningState || null,
    planningState: planningState || envelope.planningState || null,
    resolvedDestination: planningState?.destination ?? envelope.planningState?.destination ?? null,
    resolvedGeography: planningState?.tripScope ?? envelope.planningState?.tripScope ?? null,
    constraints: {
      pace: planningState?.preferences?.pace ?? envelope.planningState?.preferences?.pace ?? null,
      avoidExposure: planningState?.preferences?.avoidExposure
        ?? envelope.planningState?.preferences?.avoidExposure
        ?? null,
      fitness: planningState?.preferences?.fitness ?? envelope.planningState?.preferences?.fitness ?? null,
      interests: planningState?.preferences?.interests ?? envelope.planningState?.preferences?.interests ?? null,
      durationDays: planningState?.dates?.durationDays ?? envelope.planningState?.dates?.durationDays ?? null,
      departureCity: planningState?.transportation?.departureCity
        ?? envelope.planningState?.transportation?.departureCity
        ?? null,
      lastTravelerJob: planningState?.lastTravelerJob ?? envelope.planningState?.lastTravelerJob ?? null,
      destination: planningState?.destination ?? envelope.planningState?.destination ?? null,
    },
    evidenceRequirements: null,
    evidenceCoverage: v2.evidence || null,
    packedEvidenceSummary: v2.evidence || null,
    model: v2.model || null,
    reasoningEffort: v2.reasoningEffort || null,
    selectedTier: v2.selectedTier || null,
    attemptCount: v2.attemptCount ?? (Array.isArray(v2.attempts) ? v2.attempts.length : null),
    attempts: v2.attempts || null,
    rawTravelerFacingProse: envelope.content || '',
    canonicalPlan: plan,
    canonicalPlanDayCount: days.length,
    canonicalPlanStopNames: stopNames,
    validation: v2.validation || null,
    presentation: envelope.presentation || null,
    presentationKind: envelope.presentation?.presentationKind || null,
    terminalStatus: v2.status || null,
    cost: v2.totalCost || null,
    note: 'evidenceRequirements and packed evidence items are not in the public terminal envelope; evidenceCoverage is the live summary (topics/count/sources).',
  };
}

async function runChat({ token, messages, metadata = {}, conversationId = null }) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const body = {
    provider: 'auto',
    messages,
    metadata: {
      skipUserContext: true,
      ...metadata,
    },
    clientTurnId: `live-gate-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
  };
  if (conversationId) body.conversationId = conversationId;
  const res = await requestJson('POST', '/api/ai/chat', body, { headers: authHeaders(token) });
  const ms = Date.now() - t0;
  const data = res.json?.data || res.json || {};
  return {
    httpStatus: res.status,
    ms,
    error: data.error || res.json?.error || null,
    rawKeys: Object.keys(data || {}),
    payload: data,
    envelope: envelopeFromPayload(data),
  };
}

async function persistTrip({
  token,
  tripId,
  title,
  parkName,
  parkCode,
  conversation,
  plan,
  planningState,
}) {
  const payload = {
    parkName: parkName || 'General Planning',
    parkCode: parkCode || null,
    title,
    conversation,
    plan: plan || null,
    planningState: planningState || undefined,
    provider: 'auto',
    status: 'active',
  };
  if (tripId) {
    const res = await requestJson('PUT', `/api/trips/${tripId}`, payload, {
      headers: authHeaders(token),
      timeoutMs: 30000,
    });
    return { tripId, httpStatus: res.status, json: res.json };
  }
  const res = await requestJson('POST', '/api/trips', payload, {
    headers: authHeaders(token),
    timeoutMs: 30000,
  });
  const created = res.json?.data || {};
  return {
    tripId: created._id || created.id || null,
    httpStatus: res.status,
    json: res.json,
  };
}

function assistantMessageFromEnvelope(envelope) {
  return {
    role: 'assistant',
    content: envelope.content || '',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    provider: 'openai',
    model: envelope.trailieV2?.model || undefined,
    canonicalPlan: envelope.canonicalPlan || undefined,
    itineraryPlan: envelope.canonicalPlan || undefined,
    hasItinerary: Boolean(envelope.canonicalPlan?.days?.length),
    itineraryHash: envelope.itineraryHash || undefined,
    responseId: envelope.responseId || undefined,
    responseVersion: envelope.responseVersion ?? undefined,
    responseRevision: envelope.responseRevision ?? undefined,
    travelLogistics: envelope.travelLogistics || undefined,
    responseArtifacts: envelope.responseArtifacts || undefined,
    intent: envelope.intent || undefined,
    presentation: envelope.presentation || undefined,
    presentationKind: envelope.presentation?.presentationKind || undefined,
  };
}

function parkHintFromThread(threadId, planningState) {
  if (threadId === 'A') {
    return {
      parkName: planningState?.destination?.parkName || 'Yellowstone National Park',
      parkCode: planningState?.destination?.parkCode || 'yell',
    };
  }
  if (threadId === 'C') return { parkName: 'Zion National Park', parkCode: 'zion' };
  if (threadId === 'D') return { parkName: 'Glacier National Park', parkCode: 'glac' };
  if (threadId === 'E') return { parkName: 'Grand Teton National Park', parkCode: 'grte' };
  return {
    parkName: planningState?.destination?.parkName || 'General Planning',
    parkCode: planningState?.destination?.parkCode || null,
  };
}

async function waitForHealth(retries = 40) {
  for (let i = 0; i < retries; i += 1) {
    try {
      const res = await requestJson('GET', '/health', null, { timeoutMs: 3000 });
      if (res.status === 200 && res.json?.status === 'healthy') return res.json;
    } catch {
      /* retry */
    }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
  }
  throw new Error('Backend health check failed');
}

async function runZeroCostHardPreflight(token) {
  const res = await requestJson('GET', '/api/ai/live-gate-preflight', null, {
    headers: authHeaders(token),
    timeoutMs: 30000,
  });
  const preflight = res.json?.data || res.json || {};
  const valid = res.status === 200
    && preflight.ready === true
    && preflight.routeId === 'trailie-v2-wp11a-only'
    && Object.values(preflight.checks || {}).every((value) => value === true);
  writeJson(path.join(ROOT, 'zero-cost-preflight.json'), sanitizeForDisk({
    checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    httpStatus: res.status,
    ...preflight,
  }));
  if (!valid) {
    throw new Error(
      `ZERO_COST_PREFLIGHT_FAILED: HTTP ${res.status}; blockers=${(preflight.blockers || ['invalid_preflight_response']).join(',')}`
    );
  }
  return preflight;
}

async function main() {
  ensureDir(ROOT);
  await waitForHealth();
  const auth = await loginWithPassword();
  // This is the last step before any /chat call. It performs no provider/model
  // request and hard-stops the process on any runtime/config/auth mismatch.
  const zeroCostPreflight = await runZeroCostHardPreflight(auth.token);
  const runMeta = {
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    apiBase: API_BASE,
    only: ONLY.length ? ONLY : 'all',
    authEmail: auth.user.email,
    authUserId: auth.user.id,
    path: 'authenticated POST /api/ai/chat',
    zeroCostPreflight,
    skipUserContext: true,
    note: 'Generic paid /plan-ai V2 live gate. Exact envelopes preserved. No demo, no prompt edits.',
  };
  writeJson(path.join(ROOT, 'run-meta.json'), runMeta);
  writeJson(path.join(ROOT, 'auth-session.json'), sanitizeForDisk({
    email: auth.user.email,
    userId: auth.user.id,
    name: auth.user.name,
    role: auth.user.role,
  }));

  const selected = THREADS.filter((thread) => !ONLY.length || ONLY.includes(thread.id));
  const summary = [];

  for (const thread of selected) {
    const threadDir = path.join(ROOT, `thread-${thread.id}`);
    ensureDir(threadDir);
    let tripId = null;
    let conversation = [];
    let lastEnvelope = null;

    for (let i = 0; i < thread.turns.length; i += 1) {
      const turn = thread.turns[i];
      console.log(`\n========== Thread ${thread.id} turn ${i + 1}: ${turn.key} ==========`);
      console.log(turn.prompt);

      conversation = [
        ...conversation,
        { role: 'user', content: turn.prompt, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
      ];
      const messages = conversation.map((msg) => ({
        role: msg.role,
        content: msg.content,
        ...(msg.intent ? { intent: msg.intent } : {}),
      }));
      const metadata = {
        ...(lastEnvelope?.planningState ? { planningState: lastEnvelope.planningState } : {}),
        ...(lastEnvelope?.canonicalPlan ? { existingCanonicalPlan: lastEnvelope.canonicalPlan } : {}),
      };

      let outcome;
      const planStagesBefore = snapshotPlanStages();
      try {
        outcome = await runChat({
          token: auth.token,
          messages,
          metadata,
          conversationId: tripId,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        outcome = {
          httpStatus: 0,
          ms: 0,
          error: String(err.message || err),
          rawKeys: [],
          payload: {},
          envelope: envelopeFromPayload({}),
        };
      }

      const planStageFiles = copyChangedPlanStages(planStagesBefore, threadDir, turn.key);

      lastEnvelope = outcome.envelope;
      conversation = [
        ...conversation,
        assistantMessageFromEnvelope(outcome.envelope),
      ];

      const hint = parkHintFromThread(thread.id, outcome.envelope.planningState);
      let persisted = { tripId, httpStatus: null };
      if (outcome.httpStatus === 200 && outcome.envelope.content) {
        try {
          persisted = await persistTrip({
            token: auth.token,
            tripId,
            title: `Live gate ${thread.id}: ${thread.title}`,
            parkName: hint.parkName,
            parkCode: hint.parkCode,
            conversation,
            plan: outcome.envelope.canonicalPlan
              ? {
                ...outcome.envelope.canonicalPlan,
                responseId: outcome.envelope.responseId,
                responseVersion: outcome.envelope.responseVersion,
                responseRevision: outcome.envelope.responseRevision,
                itineraryHash: outcome.envelope.itineraryHash,
              }
              : null,
            planningState: outcome.envelope.planningState,
          });
        } catch (err) {
          persisted = { tripId, httpStatus: 0, error: String(err.message || err) };
        }
      }
      if (persisted.tripId) tripId = persisted.tripId;

      const capture = extractCapture(outcome.envelope, outcome.envelope.planningState);
      const record = sanitizeForDisk({
        thread: thread.id,
        threadTitle: thread.title,
        turn: i + 1,
        key: turn.key,
        question: turn.prompt,
        httpStatus: outcome.httpStatus,
        ms: outcome.ms,
        tripId,
        persistHttpStatus: persisted.httpStatus || null,
        error: outcome.error,
        rawKeys: outcome.rawKeys,
        planStageFiles,
        envelope: outcome.envelope,
        payload: outcome.payload,
        capture,
      });

      writeJson(path.join(threadDir, `${turn.key}-response.json`), record);
      writeJson(path.join(threadDir, `${turn.key}-envelope.json`), sanitizeForDisk({
        question: turn.prompt,
        tripId,
        ...outcome.envelope,
      }));
      writeJson(path.join(threadDir, `${turn.key}-capture.json`), sanitizeForDisk(capture));
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(threadDir, `${turn.key}-prose.txt`), outcome.envelope.content || '');

      const row = {
        thread: thread.id,
        turn: i + 1,
        key: turn.key,
        question: turn.prompt,
        tripId,
        httpStatus: outcome.httpStatus,
        ms: outcome.ms,
        status: capture.terminalStatus,
        travelerJob: capture.travelerJob,
        primaryIntent: capture.primaryIntent,
        presentationKind: capture.presentationKind,
        model: capture.model,
        reasoningEffort: capture.reasoningEffort,
        attemptCount: capture.attemptCount,
        cost: capture.cost,
        validation: capture.validation,
        hasPlan: Boolean(capture.canonicalPlanDayCount),
        dayCount: capture.canonicalPlanDayCount,
        proseLen: (outcome.envelope.content || '').length,
        lastTravelerJob: capture.constraints.lastTravelerJob,
        departureCity: capture.constraints.departureCity,
        error: outcome.error || null,
      };
      writeJson(path.join(threadDir, `${turn.key}-evaluation.json`), sanitizeForDisk(row));
      summary.push(row);

      console.log(JSON.stringify({
        thread: thread.id,
        turn: i + 1,
        http: outcome.httpStatus,
        ms: outcome.ms,
        status: row.status,
        travelerJob: row.travelerJob,
        primaryIntent: row.primaryIntent,
        presentationKind: row.presentationKind,
        model: row.model,
        cost: row.cost,
        hasPlan: row.hasPlan,
        dayCount: row.dayCount,
        tripId: row.tripId,
        error: row.error,
      }, null, 2));
    }
  }

  writeJson(path.join(ROOT, 'results-summary.json'), sanitizeForDisk({
    finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    authEmail: auth.user.email,
    results: summary,
    totalCost: summary.reduce((n, r) => {
      const cost = r.cost?.costUsd ?? r.cost;
      return n + (Number(cost) || 0);
    }, 0),
  }));
  console.log('\nDone. Summary written to results-summary.json');
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
